success.description: This attack’s CR is a minimum of 1. The attack gains +1 Pierce, and +1 damage per critical inflicted.

conservative.requirements: Fencing weapon equipped, Weapon Skill & Coordination trained. Enhances a Melee Attack. Play this card when you make a Melee Attack. You remove dice from your dice pool. If you do, you gain bonuses listed on this card for each die. If you deal 1 or more critical wounds, draw 1 extra critical and discard 1 of your choice.
